map.kWh 和 MJ 怎么换？: How to convert kWh and MJ?
map.1 kWh=3.6 MJ；能量换算用此系数，勿与功率(kW)混淆。结果按公开标准: 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ; use this factor for energy conversion, do not confuse with power (kW). Results are estimated per public standards and emission factors, for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction reference; for formal accounting follow official guidelines (e.g., GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.

Results are estimated per public standards and emission factors, for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction reference; for formal accounting follow official guidelines (e.g., GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
